Lisa saw David waiting at the train station from 8pm to 10pm.

Between what times could David have gone to the construction site?

Options:
(A) 7am to 9am
(B) 9am to 6pm
(C) 8pm to 10pm
(D) 6pm to 8pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- David was occupied from 6pm to 10pm at the airport and train station.

The only time slot not occupied by any of these activities is between 9am and 6pm. This is the only period when David could have gone to the construction site.
